name: Helyx AI
description: A gateway advertising no-card signup credit, with inconsistent public catalog claims.
overview: The signup page advertises $10 credit for new accounts via Google or GitHub. It advertises over 50 models, while the live catalog displays only eight and also mentions daily claims without clear terms. Availability, credit delivery, model identity and reliability were not tested; exercise caution.
free_access: Advertised and live catalog sizes conflict
Daily-claim terms and credit expiry unclear
notes: Endpoint https://helyxai.space/v1/chat/completions. Verify actual balance and model availability before use.
